The system must be able to accommodate multiple carrier gases, including nitrogen, helium, and hydrogen. Where necessary f

s spectrometry (GC-MS) System, with a coupled Pyrolyser Unit. The proposed GC-MS system shall be a fully programmable, high-performance instrument suitable for a broad range of analytical applications. The system must incorporate a dual column oven configuration, a single quadrupole mass spectrometry detector, and an autosampler. Additional evaluation marks may be awarded where the proposed autosampler is a connected multifunctional autosampler system capable of performing liquid injection, headspace analysis, and solid phase microextraction (SPME), with automated switching between sampling modes, as assessed in accordance with the published evaluation criteria. The system must be able to accommodate multiple carrier gases, including nitrogen, helium, and hydrogen. Where necessary for use, a high-purity hydrogen generator, complete with all associated tubing and fittings, shall be included. The system must incorporate integrated gas leak detection, automatic gas switching, and gas shut-off functionality. A split injector system is preferred.
